enriched.summary: A aula aborda vocabulário essencial para conversas técnicas e cotidianas, incluindo palavras relacionadas a tecnologia, saúde e emoções. Além disso, explora a conjugação de verbos irregulares e oferece exemplos práticos para fixação.

vocabulary.definition: Feeling sad because one has no friends or company.
examples: He felt lonely after moving to a new city.
She often feels lonely when her friends are away.

vocabulary.definition: An arrangement to receive something regularly, typically a service.
examples: I have a subscription to video game platforms.
She canceled her magazine subscription.

vocabulary.definition: Evoking admiration through size, quality, or skill.
examples: The performance was truly impressive.
He has an impressive collection of antique cars.

vocabulary.definition: A form of alternative medicine involving thin needles inserted into the body.
examples: Acupuncture is used to relieve pain.
She tried acupuncture to reduce stress.
That movie was scary!
The thunderstorm was scary for the kids.
Nowadays, people rely on technology more than ever.
Nowadays, working remotely has become common.

vocabulary.definition: A feature that makes something stand out from others.
examples: Technical expertise with the human touch is our differentiator.
Our product’s key differentiator is its affordability.

vocabulary.definition: Made or adapted for a particular purpose or person.
examples: We offer tailored solutions to our clients.
The suit was tailored to fit him perfectly.

vocabulary.definition: To take or go with something or someone to a place.
examples: Bring – brought – brought: trazer – trouxe – trazido
Can you bring me a glass of water?

vocabulary.definition: Moving in one side and out of the other side.
examples: He went through the tunnel.
I learned a lot through experience.

vocabulary.definition: Continuous physical force exerted on or against something.
examples: Through pressure, the team achieved their goals.
There’s a lot of pressure to succeed in this job.

vocabulary.definition: To cause someone to do something through reasoning or argument.
examples: I need to persuade our clients to use our products.
He persuaded her to go on the trip.

vocabulary.definition: Consisting of many interconnecting parts; difficult to understand.
examples: The situation is very complicated.
This math problem looks complicated.
They are called programmers who do vibe coding.
The boy called his mother for help.

grammar.explanation: Irregular verbs do not follow the standard rules for conjugation in the past and past participle forms.
rules: Memorize the forms of irregular verbs.
examples: Bring – brought – brought: trazer – trouxe – trazido
commonMistakes: Using regular conjugation for irregular verbs.
Confusing past and past participle forms.

practiceQuestions.question: Conjugate the verb 'bring' in past tense.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The past tense of 'bring' is 'brought', as it is an irregular verb.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate 'Nowadays, people rely on technology more than ever.'
practiceQuestions.answer: Hoje em dia, as pessoas dependem da tecnologia mais do que nunca.
practiceQuestions.explanation: The sentence uses 'nowadays' to indicate current time.

culturalNotes: The use of tailored services is common in professional settings to meet specific client needs.
studyTips: Practice irregular verbs daily to improve retention.
Use flashcards for vocabulary to enhance memorization.
